mechanism: Moxifloxacin may increase the anticoagulant effect of propylthiouracil through CYP450 inhibition and potential displacement of protein binding, while propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis which is potentiated by fluoroquinolone-associated myelosuppression.
action: Monitor CBC regularly during concurrent use; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; counsel patient on signs of infection and bleeding.
